entries.title: The task board stays short, however many tasks you have
entries.body: The board now shows the work underway: Waiting on you above Queued, Working and this week's Done, five at a time. Your backlog, all of this week's done tasks and dropped tasks open as lists of twenty a page, and every count is the whole list's. Find also lists matching done tasks from before this week, apart from this week's.

picture.alt: The task board with Waiting on you above Queued, Working and Done columns, and Board, Backlog and Done buttons with their counts
